chapter: Breakup of Hines band to Lefty Bates
title: Eleven years with Lefty Bates: Trocadero and breakfast dances

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Cabarets, honky-tonks and the Storyville nightlife scene

blocks.x: Eleven years. And then you went into the --
What were some of the places you worked around town with Lefty?
The main place we worked with Lefty Bates was always -- jumped on Monday mornings, after -- at least the breakfast dance was the Trocadero
That was in the basement on 47th and Indiana.
I think I was at that -- that was one of those big old stone houses out there?
It was down in the basement of a hotel.
Well, I was at a place out there one time with John Steiner several years ago.

And this lady owned the building, and she used to have an after-hours place down in her basement, which she still has. Doesn't run it any more. And she had pictures of Louie, and Earl, and all these -- Sid Catlett, all these guys that had been there. Yeah, you worked at that place, too?
Yeah, I worked there, too, with Lefty.
Are there places like that any more?
I think there's one at 48th and Indiana, down in the basement, that's still going. Blues joint.
